```{julia}
#| include: false

# Common libraries
using BioinfoTools
using Profile
using CairoMakie

# Test data
genome_file = joinpath(@__DIR__, "../data/genomic.gff.gz")

# Helper functions
rnd(x) = round(x, digits=1)
```

# BioifnoTools Profiling
This document contains profiling information for BioinfoTools. It is organized into sections based on modules.

*NOTE*: The Julia code executed to generate the profiling information uses a pre-compiled system image to avoid compilation time in the profiling results. This means that the profiling information may not reflect the performance of the code when run from a cold start.

-[GFF](#gff)

## GFF
```{julia}
#| echo: true
#| output: false

# warmup
test_genome = GFF.loadgenome(genome_file, feature_type="all")
test_genome = nothing
GC.gc()

# profile
allocs_mini = @allocations GFF.loadgenome(genome_file)
allocs_full = @allocations GFF.loadgenome(genome_file, feature_type="all")
```

### `loadgenome`
| Input (size) | Bytes Allocated (mini) | Bytes Allocated (full) |
|---|---|---|---|
| genomic.gff.gz (`{julia} genome_file |> filesize |> rnd`) | `{julia} allocs_mini |> rnd` | `{julia} allocs_full |> rnd` |
